annotations.title: x402 market data: measured uptime, latency and quoted prices of paid x402 endpoints

description: Use when choosing or checking a paid x402 API. Input: q (task or keywords; optional max_price, network, limit 1-20, min_uptime 0-1) or url (one x402 resource). Output: JSON endpoints with our own measurements: 7-day uptime, p50/p95 latency, last quoted price and changes, networks, last checked, reliability score, plus price p25/median/p75. Measured by unpaid probes (402 quote only). Example: ?q=weather&min_uptime=0.9 Price: $0.003 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

max_price.description: Only endpoints priced at or below this many USD per call (index price)

min_uptime.description: Only endpoints whose measured 7-day uptime is at least this fraction

network.description: Only endpoints that accept this network: base, solana, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, ethereum, avalanche, worldchain, monad, or a CAIP-2 id

q.description: What the API should do, in plain words or keywords. Text only: never fetched as a URL. Give q or url

url.description: One x402 resource URL (https) to get its measured stats
